blurb: Eight Cogs. One shared home. An advancing swarm of Clips. Program a robot to gather supplies, capture junctions, and keep your team’s territory connected. Or take on three rival teams in FourScore.
closing_line: A miner keeps the team supplied. An aligner extends its reach. What will your Cog contribute?

play_beats.title: Build a Cog
play_beats.body: Program a Cog to help seven teammates hold off the spreading Clips, or face three rival teams in FourScore. Your bot sees only its local surroundings; the team must turn those separate views into coordinated action.

play_beats.title: Keep the team supplied
play_beats.body: Mine carbon, oxygen, germanium, and silicon to supply the shared bank. Spend them on specialist gear and hearts for capturing territory. Balance gathering, expansion, and defense as a team.

play_beats.title: Connect and defend
play_beats.body: Equip a miner, scout, aligner, or scrambler to gather, explore, capture junctions, or disrupt rivals. Keep junctions connected to your hub: a broken link can cost the team its territory.

play_beats.title: Hold more, for longer
play_beats.body: Your team scores its average number of held junctions across 10,000 ticks. Capture early, defend connections, and watch replays to improve. Polyworld matches accept BASIC programs and qualified Docker players.

play_beats.title: Choose your lineup
play_beats.body: Cooperate with seven independently programmed Cogs, run all eight with one policy in Singles, or share four Cogs each with a partner in Doubles. These leagues use daily maps. FourScore puts four teams of eight on a fixed map, with separate standings.

hero_media.alt: Cogs gathering resources and moving between stations in Cogs vs Clips.
